surface_request: Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.
plan:
SOURCE: The tar archive at tar_path and its members.
TRUST: dest_path is the trusted extraction boundary; all archive contents are untrusted.
SINK: Filesystem paths strictly beneath dest_path where regular files and directories are created.
GUARD: Reject every symbolic-link and hard-link member, including those whose targets appear inside dest_path; normalize each member path and reject any resolving outside dest_path; permit only regular files and directories.
ORDER: Inspect each archive member before extraction; validate its type and normalized path, then write permitted regular files and directories, aborting and returning False immediately on any validation or extraction failure.
EFFECT: Return True when every validated member is successfully extracted beneath dest_path; return False on any failure while ensuring no archive member is written outside dest_path.
END_PLAN
